landing.badge: Built for Surinamese legislation and payroll practice
landing.title: Payroll for Suriname, done right — every month.
landing.subtitle: ARA Payroll helps small businesses, large companies and accounting firms run accurate payroll in any currency, generate payslips and stay compliant — all in the cloud.

employees.title: Employee administration
employees.text: Personnel files, contracts, salary history, bank details and documents in one secure place.

engine.title: Surinamese payroll engine
engine.text: Loonbelasting, AOV, heffingskorting, forfaitaire aftrek, overtime and special rewards — with versioned, editable tax tables.

multicurrency.title: Multicurrency
multicurrency.text: Salaries in SRD, USD, EUR and more, with approved, recorded exchange rates and reporting in your base currency.

payslips.title: Professional payslips
payslips.text: Clear PDF payslips in Dutch or English, available instantly through employee self-service.

leave.title: Leave management
leave.text: Requests, approvals and balances for annual, sick, maternity and other leave types.

security.title: Secure by design
security.text: Role-based access, full audit trail, approval workflow and locked payroll periods.

currency.baseText: {currency} is the reporting currency of {company}. Payroll totals and reports are expressed in this currency.

tax.warning: Statutory rates (loonbelasting brackets, heffingskorting, AOV, overtime and special-reward rules) change through Surinamese legislation. ARA Payroll ships with starting values that must be checked against current Belastingdienst Suriname publications. Rule sets are versioned by effective date; approved payroll keeps the version it was calculated with.
tax.versionsSub: The most recent version effective on the last day of a payroll period is used. Company versions take precedence over platform defaults.
tax.summary: Effective {date} · {currency} · AOV {aov} · tax credit {credit}/month · top rate {top}

tax.calcCurrencyHint: Statutory currency; other currencies are converted into it.
tax.saved: Tax rule set saved. Mark it as verified once checked against current legislation.
